claims: Ja'Marr Chase signed a four-year, $161 million contract extension with the Cincinnati Bengals in March 2025.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension includes $112 million guaranteed.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension has an annual average of $40.25 million.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension made him the highest-paid non-quarterback in NFL history at the time of signing.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension extends his stay through 2029.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension surpassed the previous high for non-QBs held by Myles Garrett.
Ja'Marr Chase's contract extension surpassed wide receiver market leaders like Justin Jefferson.
Ja'Marr Chase's deal was finalized alongside a four-year, $115M extension for teammate Tee Higgins.
Spotrac indicates the cap percentage for Ja'Marr Chase rises from 8.28% in 2025 to 11.66% by 2028.
